title: Recon File Generator->Verify Backend File Naming Convention
objective:
This test case use to verify Generated file name shall follow the format: 
<ConfigurationName>_<GenDate>.CSV 
Where:  

<ConfigurationName> = exact user-entered configuration name  

<GenDate> = system timestamp in YYYYMMDDHHmmss format based on server/system time zone  

Extension shall always be .CSV
preconditions: User should login with valid credentials.

steps.action: Go to System configuration → Recon file generator
Fill all details and click on save button.
steps.expectedResult: Recon file generator record should save .
